analysis.text:
## Price position (ARBA Selling Price)
- **Seoul Basic vs Lurima Seoul Lite:** Lurima looks 37–43% cheaper, but without a hotel. After adding its RM1,020 hotel and K-ETA, Lurima's like-for-like price is RM2,800 (3 pax), RM2,550 (4 pax), RM2,310 (6 pax), RM2,340 (8 pax) — **ARBA is the same or cheaper at every pax** (RM3 cheaper at 3 pax, RM243 cheaper at 8 pax). Lurima's prices are 2025 — 2026 may be higher still.
- **Seoul Standard vs Muslim full-board packages:** ARBA is **much cheaper** — Jeju Muslim Travel +16% (4 pax) to +46% (6 pax), Selamat Bercuti +40% to +75%, Sedunia +54% to +110%. These competitors include halal lunch / dinner, so part of the gap is the cost of meals.

## Inclusion differences
- ARBA is the only one that clearly includes **tipping and K-ETA** in both packages.
- Full-board competitors sell **halal meals included** as their main value; ARBA Standard is breakfast only.
- Lurima sells a **Malay-speaking guide** living in Korea — a USP ARBA Basic does not have.
- Selamat Bercuti and Sedunia have **shopping stops** (Sedunia compulsory, skipping costs +RM900) — ARBA can pitch "no tourist traps".

## Risks
- Customers comparing the advertised "from RM1,190" will see ARBA Basic as about twice the price, although like-for-like ARBA is cheaper.
- For 2–3 pax, Jeju Muslim Travel and Sedunia have no price — room for ARBA.
actions: In Seoul Basic ads, show the price as 'incl. hotel, tipping & K-ETA' — like-for-like ARBA is already cheaper than Lurima.
No need to cut Seoul Basic prices; keep the margin and win on 'all-in' messaging.
Add a 'halal meals' add-on (lunch + dinner) to Seoul Standard — still well below Jeju Muslim / Selamat Bercuti.
Sales pitch for Standard: no shopping stops, tipping & K-ETA included, 16–110% cheaper than Muslim full-board packages.
Consider a Malay-speaking guide as an upgrade to compete with Lurima.
Ask Lurima and Jeju Muslim Travel for 2026 quotes (their pages still show 2025 prices).

## Price position (ARBA Selling Price)
**Osaka Basic** is well below JomJapan Osaka Kyoto 5D4N: +50.5% at 2 pax, +28.7% at 4 pax, +26.4% at 6 pax and +30.1% at 8 pax. **Osaka Standard** is cheaper than Lurima Osaka Kyoto 5D4N: +5.8% at 4 pax, +14.0% at 6 pax and +8.6% at 8 pax.

## Inclusion differences
- JomJapan includes 3 halal lunches, 3 mosque visits and Kobe, but Day 4 is free & easy (no guide).
- Lurima uses a Malaysian driver-guide on a 9-hr day with Osaka entrance fees; ARBA gives 10 hrs.
- All exclude dinners; ARBA and Lurima include tipping.

## Risks
- ARBA itineraries list no mosque stop in Kansai — competitors make mosque visits a headline.
- Lurima's price table columns are loosely labelled; adult figure used is the first column.
- JomJapan prices carry no validity date.
actions: Add an Osaka or Kobe Mosque prayer stop to the Basic/Standard itineraries and catalogue
Pitch Standard as private transport + 10-hr day for less than Lurima's 9-hr Malaysian-guide tour
Promote Basic 2-pax (RM4,497) vs JomJapan's RM6,770 for couples
Consider a Kobe add-on day to match JomJapan's coverage

## Price position (ARBA Selling Price)
Compared **Bali Standard 4D3N** (3★, all pax) and **Honeymoon Standard** (2 pax); Honeymoon Premium skipped (no like-for-like halal pool-villa competitor). Standard is far below both Muslim competitors: IKHLAS is +104.2% to +123.2% above ARBA, HolidayGoGoGo +73.5% to +108.8% like-for-like (incl. ~RM40 tipping). Honeymoon Standard is the exception: IKHLAS Honeymoon is RM1045/pax vs ARBA RM999 — only +4.6%, i.e. RM46 per pax. HolidayGoGoGo honeymoon (4★) is +97.1% like-for-like.

## Inclusion differences
IKHLAS and HolidayGoGoGo sell full or near-full board; ARBA Standard gives breakfast + 1 dinner only. IKHLAS honeymoon adds a 2-hr massage, Bali Swing, banana boat and candle-light dinner; ARBA counters with a private pool-villa night and Nusa Penida. Both competitors use English-speaking guides; HolidayGoGoGo excludes tipping.

## Risks
The huge gap on Standard partly reflects ARBA's thin meal plan — customers comparing "per pax" may assume ARBA is all-in. Honeymoon Standard is almost at parity with an IKHLAS package that bundles more extras.
actions: Keep Bali Standard price; pitch it as 'half the price of full-board Muslim packages' and offer a halal lunch/dinner add-on
Honeymoon Standard: add one low-cost extra (massage or Bali Swing) or trim price to beat IKHLAS by more than RM46/pax
Lead honeymoon sales with the private pool-villa night and Nusa Penida — neither IKHLAS nor HolidayGoGoGo honeymoon has both

## Price position (ARBA Selling Price)
**Standard 5D4N vs privatetour.my Perth 5D4N:** ARBA is far cheaper at every pax: privatetour.my is 119.9% higher at 2 pax (RM10,988 vs RM4,997), 137.3% at 4 pax, 96.5% at 6 pax and 82.5% at 8 pax. Like-for-like (+RM210 for lunches and Caversham entry ARBA includes) the gap is RM6,201 at 2 pax and RM2,601 at 8 pax.

**Standard vs AMI Wonderful Perth (Ground Santai, min 5 pax):** AMI is 16.6% below ARBA at 6 pax and 13.8% below at 8 pax (RM2,498). Like-for-like with ~RM60 tipping, ARBA is RM439 higher at 6 and RM339 higher at 8.

## Inclusion differences
- privatetour.my adds Pinnacles + Lancelin and a Malay-speaking driver, but excludes meals and entrance tickets.
- AMI Santai gives 3 tour days with halal lunch daily and a city apartment; ARBA gives 2 tour days, 2 lunches and an apartment outside the CBD.
- ARBA includes tipping; both competitors' visa fees and AMI's tipping are excluded.

## Risks
- AMI's table expired 31 Jan 2026 (archived copy); privatetour.my gives no validity date.
- For groups of 6–8, AMI offers more tour days for less money.

analysis.text:
## Price position (ARBA Selling Price)
ARBA is far cheaper than the only published private/organised Kundasang packages found. 3D2N: Amazing Borneo's private guided tour (RM1,488, 4+ pax) is +97% vs ARBA at 4 pax (RM757), +110% at 6 and +120% at 8; like-for-like with RM60 entrance/tipping estimate it is +104% to +129%. 4D3N: Amazing Borneo's join-in Family Package C is +34% at 2 pax (RM1,690 vs RM1,257) and +58% to +76% at 4–8 pax. No Malaysian Muslim agency publishes a priced private Kundasang package.

## Inclusion differences
Amazing Borneo gives a licensed guide, Kinabalu Park/Poring and more dinners; the 4D3N version adds all entrance fees, a 4★ KK hotel and a dinner cruise. ARBA offers a private car from 2 pax, tipping included, a KK city night and (4D3N) an island day, but only a driving guide and few meals.

## Risks
The operator is foreign-market oriented and does not state halal meals, so it is not a like-for-like Muslim-family product. Real price pressure is more likely from unlisted WhatsApp/Facebook Sabah drivers, which this research could not price. ARBA's very low price may undersell its value.
actions: Hold or test a modest increase on 4–8 pax tiers; ARBA sits roughly half the published operator price
Add Kinabalu Park (and Poring if open) to the 3D2N itinerary to match the main operator route
Pitch 'private car from 2 pax + tipping included + halal handled' vs minimum-4-pax operator tours
Consider including 1–2 more halal dinners to close the meal gap at low cost
Survey local Sabah driver-guide pages (Facebook/WhatsApp) for the true low-end benchmark

## Price position (ARBA Selling Price)
Compared on the 1★ water chalet tier (main seller); 2★/3★ and honeymoon rows skipped. ARBA's flat RM1,197 (2–10 pax) is the cheapest water-chalet product found. 3D2N: Blue Star's Seastar package (RM1,471, 2 pax) is +23%; vs ARBA's 2★ chalet tier (RM1,597) it is -8%. The 4D3N tier is exposed: budget sellers offer 2 island days at about half ARBA's price, while ARBA adds 2 F&E days. Blue Star prices are 2-pax only with no stated validity. Halal meals are not stated by any competitor.

## Price position (ARBA Selling Price)
ARBA is the most expensive option at both resorts. Shari-La: Mango Vacations' low-season twin rate (RM470) is -48% vs ARBA at 2 pax (RM897) and -41% at 8 pax (RM797); adding RM100 for the missing lunches/dinners it is still -36% to -28%. HolidayGoGoGo's full-board Shari-La from-price (RM465) is -48% at 2 pax. Mimpi: HolidayGoGoGo's from-price (RM1,130) is -19% vs ARBA RM1,397.

## Inclusion differences
Inclusions are almost identical: shared boat from Kuala Besut, full board, one snorkelling trip; the Mimpi rival adds the same windmill trek. Mango is breakfast-only. ARBA includes tipping; all rivals exclude marine park/council fees, as ARBA does.

## Risks
These are resort-direct style packages that customers can compare in minutes, so ARBA's premium is very visible. HolidayGoGoGo shows from-prices only, so real 2-pax rates may be higher. Perhentian closes 15 Oct–15 Feb, so prices matter for the 2027 season opening.
actions: Re-cost Shari-La 2–8 pax toward the RM570–610 like-for-like range (Mango low/shoulder + meals); keep tipping and hand-holding as the premium
Re-check Mimpi supplier rate; target within 10% of the published RM1,130 agency price
Sell value beyond the room: jetty transfer from Kota Bharu/Kuala Besut, halal assurance, single contact
Publish season-split prices (low/shoulder/peak) like competitors before the Feb 2027 reopening
Push Perhentian mainly as 10+ pax group trips, where ARBA's tiers drop to RM747 or lower
